ios.desc:
Learn by doing
The only way to truly understand something is to experience it. By following along as your mentor guides you step-by-step to mastering a new skill, Workshop lets you skip the lectures and do more of what you love.

Hand-crafted courses
Starting with the world of cooking and now introducing art, Workshop gives you access to a range of top-quality educational content. With free sessions, self-paced workshops and guided courses, everything on Workshop has been carefully crafted to give you the best learning experiences.

Set your own pace
No matter how big and complex the new skill, Workshop helps break it down into small and manageable steps for you to learn at your own pace – giving you complete control over how, when and where you learn.

Reflect on your journey
As you develop your skills, you can track your progress by uploading photos to your personal in-app journal and share your new abilities with the world.

Try out a new way of learning today by getting started on a free session of your choice.
